thread:
Ivy Nguyen: saw a pattern of duplicate side-effects when fastpath->slowpath handoffs happen and the client retries mid-stream. thinking we should protocolize the exchange rather than ad-hoc headers.
Omar Khan: agreed. what do you mean by protocolize? a tiny handshake for resumes?
Ivy Nguyen: sketch: define a lightweight resume handshake using a single header `X-RW-Resume-Token: v1:<base64>` that the gateway issues when it can resume a stream. Also a `X-RW-Retry-Origin: gateway|client|upstream`. Gateway-origin resumes include a token; client-origin retries without token are rejected.
Meera Patel: I like tokens. operational constraints: we cannot buffer arbitrary bodies, so token must encode resumable offset + a small resume-id that maps to short-lived state in the gateway KV. Token TTL enforced by gateway.
Diego Alvarez: bikeshed name: `X-RW-*` avoids colliding with customers. Policy proposal: 1) if retry arrives before body commit (headers only) -> accept and coalesce. 2) if mid-stream and client provides `X-RW-Resume-Token` -> resume if token valid. 3) if mid-stream and no token -> 425 Too Early with JSON error `{"error":"resume_token_required","docs":"/edge/retries"}` and header `X-RW-Retry-Allowed:false`.
Omar Khan: interesting use of 425. It's unusual but maps semantically to "too early to retry" for streaming flows. We'll need to document SDK guidance so clients don't interpret 425 as transient network problems.
Ivy Nguyen: additional fields: when gateway issues a resume token it should also emit `X-RW-Retry-Id: <uuid>` and `X-RW-Retry-TTL: 30` so downstream services and ops can correlate. Token format: v1:<base64(Json{route,offset,expiry,nonce})>. We keep the KV mapping tiny (nonce->resume-state).
Meera Patel: metrics: ingress.retry_origin.{gateway,client,upstream}, ingress.retry_resume.success, ingress.retry_resume.failure, ingress.retry_rejected_no_token. Also quota consideration: resumed streams should be charged as single logical request; we need to ensure billing dedupes by `Retry-Id`.
Diego Alvarez: implement notes: 1) route config controls whether resumable streams are allowed; default off for routes that perform side effects unless idempotency is explicit. 2) GC resume-state after TTL and enforce max-resume-state-per-route. 3) log entries include retry-id and nonce for tracing.
Ivy Nguyen: test plan: unit tests for token generation/validation, integration test simulating fastpath->slowpath with token handshake, and a failure mode where token expired leading to 425. I'll draft the RFC with curl examples. Sample error response to document:
``
HTTP/1.1 425 Too Early
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-Retry-Allowed: false

{"error":"resume_token_required","docs":"https://docs.redwood.ai/edge/retries#resume"}
```
ops-bot: rollout scheduled: feature/resume-tokens (PR #4501) \u2014 CI green :white_check_mark:
Omar Khan: SDK guidance: 1) don't auto-retry streaming bodies unless you get a resume token; 2) if you get 425, surface instruction to user to attach Idempotency-Key or follow docs; 3) support token refresh in advanced SDKs.
Ivy Nguyen: thanks all. I'll put the RFC up and attach small harness logs. tagging eng-runtime, eng-platform, and devex.
